title: Molecular Synthesis Reactor
description: The user operates a steampunk-inspired chemical synthesis reactor. Interlocking gears represent the catalytic engine that drives reactions, while the SpecularSilkPouf serves as a soft, iridescent reaction vessel (a 'plasma cushion reactor'). The user must adjust gear speed, inject reagents, and monitor the reaction vessel as it changes color through synthesis stages to produce a target compound.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive molecular synthesis reactor. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: Place the gears model on the left side of the scene, scaled appropriately, representing a catalytic drive mechanism. Place the SpecularSilkPouf on the right, scaled up 2x, representing a soft plasma reaction vessel. Add a metallic pipe connecting them (a simple cylinder). Use a dark lab background (color #1a1a2e). Add ambient light (intensity 0.4), a warm point light near the gears (orange, intensity 1.5), and a cool point light near the pouf (blue, intensity 1.2). Camera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at scene center with OrbitControls. Interactions (5 steps): Step 1 - Click a 'Start Catalyst' HTML button to begin spinning the gears continuously using animation mixer or manual rotation in the render loop. Step 2 - Use an HTML slider labeled 'Reaction Speed' (range 1-10) to control gear rotation speed. Step 3 - Click one of three reagent buttons (Hydrogen-blue, Oxygen-red, Carbon-green) to inject a reagent, visualized as small colored spheres traveling along the pipe from gears to pouf. Step 4 - When a reagent reaches the pouf, the pouf material emissive color blends with the reagent color, and a particle burst effect (20 small spheres expanding outward) appears around it. Step 5 - After injecting all three reagents in the correct order (H, O, C), the pouf glows bright white, gears stop, and a success banner displays 'Formaldehyde (CH2O) Synthesized!' with a restart button. Track injected reagents in an array. Display current compound formula as an overlay. If wrong order, flash red and reset reagent progress. Ensure all materials on the pouf are modified to support emissive changes by traversing its scene graph.
